hero-balance.purpose: The single biggest number on Home — the player's chip stack. Animated by ChipCount.

display.purpose: Page-level Cormorant headings and celebratory moments.

body.purpose: All readable copy, set in Jost.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked eyebrow labels, ≤4 words, gold-300 at ~70%.

shadows.name: deco-float
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift under deco-card surfaces — diffuse and dark, floats a card off the felt.

shadows.name: gold-glow
shadows.purpose: Warm halo on the primary gold button and active accents — lit from within.

motion.name: chip-pop
motion.purpose: Scale bounce-in when a new chip stack lands (0.6 → 1.08 → 1).

motion.name: count-flash
motion.purpose: Champagne-gold to bone flash when the balance rises — the feel of a win.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback on every button (touch, not hover).

components.name: Gold Button (primary)
components.description: The one 'do this' action per screen — gold gradient, near-black text, warm glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0a0f0d; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e6c75b, #b8941f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.35), 0 8px 30px -8px rgba(212,175,55,0.25); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, filter 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2dd8c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (secondary)
components.description: The default for everything that isn't the hero action — felt fill, thin gold border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.30); border-radius: 0.75rem; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #f4efe1; background: rgba(15,42,31,0.5); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.6); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2dd8c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive or loss-confirming actions only — translucent ruby.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(155,34,38,0.6); border-radius: 0.75rem; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #f4efe1; background: rgba(155,34,38,0.2); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(155,34,38,0.32); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4efe1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dark felt fill, thin gold border that brightens on focus, 52px tall.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.25); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: rgba(10,15,13,0.6); color: #f4efe1; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(244,239,225,0.3); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.7); }

components.name: Deco Card
components.description: The house container — felt-800 at 70% with backdrop blur, gold hairline, soft float. Never nested.
components.css: .ds-deco-card { border-radius: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.20); background: rgba(11,31,23,0.7); box-shadow: 0 10px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(242,221,140,0.7); } .ds-card-value { margin: 0; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; color: #f2dd8c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Pill
components.description: Small bordered tag in four semantic tones — gold (default), jade (win), ruby (loss), muted.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pill-gold { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.4); color: #f2dd8c; } .ds-pill-jade { border-color: rgba(42,157,111,0.5); color: #2a9d6f; } .ds-pill-ruby { border-color: rgba(155,34,38,0.6); color: #c23a3f; } .ds-pill-muted { border-color: rgba(244,239,225,0.2); color: rgba(244,239,225,0.6); }

components.name: Chip Count (signature)
components.description: The soul of the app — a large tabular Cormorant number that animates and flashes gold on a win.
components.css: .ds-chip-count { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 3.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; color: #f2dd8c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; animation: ds-count-flash 0.8s ease-out; } @keyframes ds-count-flash { 0% { color: #f2dd8c; } 100% { color: #f4efe1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip-count { animation: none; } }

components.name: Bottom Tab Nav
components.description: The only navigation — fixed bottom bar, emoji icon over tracked label, gold-glow active tab.
components.html: 🏠Home🎲Games➤Send🍸Shop
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; border-top: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2); background: rgba(10,15,13,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.125rem; padding: 0.625rem 0; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: rgba(244,239,225,0.45); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-ico { font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-nav-active { color: #f2dd8c; } .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-ico { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(212,175,55,0.6)); }

narrative.overview: A grown-up birthday game night dressed in Art Deco finery: green felt, candlelight, a glass of bubbly, and friends who all feel like high-roller regulars for one evening. The chips are the toy; the party is the point. Celebratory and social first, with just enough hushed-club glamour (gold leaf on deep felt) to make a tap feel like a small thrill. Built for a specific body — someone standing in a dim, noisy room, holding a drink, glancing for two seconds — so the glamour rides on real discipline: balance and primary action readable at arm's length, 52px tap targets, and a restate-before-it-happens confirm on every chip move. It rejects Vegas (neon, slot flash, jackpot gradients), the generic SaaS dashboard, and anything that smells of real-money gambling.
keyCharacteristics: Deep felt-green canvas, near-black, with a single warm gold as the star accent
A serif display voice (Cormorant Garamond) over a clean geometric sans body (Jost)
Tactile, oversized buttons (52px+) tuned for standing, distracted, one-handed use
Chips animate: a gold count-flash on a win, a soft pop when a stack lands
Mobile-only, single-column, bottom-tab navigation — never pretends to be a desktop app

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: Gold is the most expensive ink in the building. Spend it on value and action: the balance, the primary CTA, the active tab, a thin border or divider. Two solid-gold buttons on one screen and gold stops meaning anything. One gold decision per view.

rules.name: The Win/Loss-Only Rule
rules.body: Jade and ruby are forbidden as decoration or theme color. They are semantic signals for chips gained and chips lost. If a jade element doesn't mean a win and a ruby element doesn't mean a loss or danger, it's the wrong color.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-For-Show Rule
rules.body: Cormorant is for numbers, headings, and celebration. Jost is for everything a guest has to read and act on. Body copy, buttons, and form values are never set in the serif.

rules.name: The Readable-Bone Rule
rules.body: Primary text is full-strength Bone (#f4efe1), never a faded tint. Bone at ≤50% opacity is for genuinely secondary metadata only, never for anything a standing guest in a dim room needs to read.

rules.name: The Candlelight Rule
rules.body: Shadows are warm and soft, never hard and gray. If an element looks like it has a crisp gray 2014-Material box-shadow, deepen and diffuse it, or replace it with a felt tonal step and a gold hairline border.

dos: Do keep the balance and the one primary action the two loudest things on every screen — readable at arm's length in a dim room.
Do spend gold sparingly: one gold CTA per view, gold elsewhere only as thin borders, dividers, the balance, and the active tab.
Do set headings, numbers, and celebratory moments in Cormorant; set everything readable in Jost.
Do keep primary text full-strength Bone (#f4efe1) and verify AA contrast on felt; reserve faded bone (≤50%) for true secondary metadata only.
Do keep tap targets ≥52px and confirm-restate every chip move ('Send 50 chips to Anna?') before it happens.
Do use jade strictly for wins and ruby strictly for losses/danger, always paired with a label, sign, or icon.
Do give the chip counter room to animate; let a win flash gold and a stack pop.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion with a calm crossfade or instant fallback for chip-pop, count-flash, and shimmer.
donts: Don't go Vegas neon or gaudy: no glowing neon, no slot-machine flash, no jackpot gradients, no cheap chip clip-art.
Don't let this read as a generic SaaS dashboard — no flat gray cards, no system-font admin tables, no soulless white panels.
Don't borrow real-money-gambling tropes: no FOMO mechanics, no aggressive green-number dopamine UI.
Don't nest a card inside a card; separate content with a felt tonal step or a deco-divider.
Don't put two solid-gold buttons on one screen — gold stops meaning anything when it competes with itself.
Don't set body copy, button labels, or form values in Cormorant; the serif is for show, not for reading.
Don't rely on hard, gray, 2014-Material box-shadows; shadows here are warm, soft, and candle-lit.
Don't design for desktop. This is a centered 28rem mobile column with a bottom tab bar; never stretch it wide or add a sidebar.
